subsystems.name: Constraint and parameter model
subsystems.role: defines the design space, site conditions, budget and building-code limits.

subsystems.name: Generative engine
subsystems.role: produces many candidate building designs automatically.
parts: generative adversarial networks (GANs) or diffusion models

subsystems.name: Structural analysis module
subsystems.role: checks that each candidate can actually stand up under loads.

subsystems.name: Performance simulation
subsystems.role: scores designs on energy, daylight, cost and carbon.

subsystems.name: Multi-objective optimiser
subsystems.role: ranks thousands of designs against competing goals.

subsystems.name: Human-in-the-loop interface
subsystems.role: lets architects set intent, inspect options and refine choices.

subsystems.name: BIM and documentation exporter
subsystems.role: turns a selected design into construction documents.

buildSteps.title: Define the design brief and constraints
buildSteps.detail: Capture site boundaries, floor area targets, budget, and the relevant building codes as machine-readable rules.

buildSteps.title: Build a parametric model of the building
buildSteps.detail: Create a geometry model where dimensions and shapes are driven by adjustable parameters, so the generative engine can vary them.

buildSteps.title: Integrate simulation tools
buildSteps.detail: Connect structural (FEA), energy, daylight and cost simulators so each generated design can be evaluated automatically.

buildSteps.title: Configure or train the generative algorithms
buildSteps.detail: Set up evolutionary search for optimisation, and train generative models on existing building plans if a data-driven approach is used.

buildSteps.title: Run the generative loop
buildSteps.detail: The engine produces thousands of variants, each automatically simulated for structural soundness, energy use and cost.

buildSteps.title: Filter variants
buildSteps.detail: Discard designs that fail structural checks or violate building codes, keeping only feasible candidates.

buildSteps.title: Optimise and rank
buildSteps.detail: Use multi-objective optimisation to sort the surviving designs into a trade-off front between cost, carbon, daylight and other goals.

buildSteps.title: Present options to architects
buildSteps.detail: Show the ranked designs in an interactive 3D interface so humans can select, combine or refine promising options.

buildSteps.title: Export to BIM for construction
buildSteps.detail: The chosen design is converted into a BIM model, detailed drawings and schedules ready for permitting and construction.

prerequisites.why: needed to represent building geometry in a way that algorithms can manipulate and later document.
to verify that generated designs can carry gravity, wind and seismic loads.
GANs and diffusion models are used in research, but reliability for full building design is not yet proven.
generating and simulating thousands of designs needs large-scale, parallel compute.
many rules exist as text and drawings rather than structured data, limiting full automation.

pathway.milestone: generative design tools assist architects by exploring options under human guidance
pathway.unlocks: faster early-stage design and better-informed trade-off decisions.

pathway.milestone: AI agents autonomously generate, simulate and rank designs, with human oversight
pathway.unlocks: designs that are structurally sound and code-compliant from the outset, cutting rework.

pathway.milestone: tight integration with robotic construction and digital twins
pathway.unlocks: designs optimised for automated fabrication and real-time performance monitoring.

pathway.milestone: end-to-end autonomous design-to-construction pipelines for standard building types
pathway.unlocks: rapid, low-cost delivery of housing and infrastructure where demand outstrips design capacity.
